ceu: ✦ The square between Mercury and Neptune

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: It is a day of quiet transformation. What ends today leaves room for something truer.
The square between Mercury and Neptune creates some tension between family and your image. Put off big decisions until the dust settles.
With Mercury retrograde in your home and family sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Take a long bath and imagine the water carrying away the weight of the day.

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: The Moon passes through your opposite sign and puts other people at the centre of the day. Today listening is worth more than talking.
The square between Mercury and Neptune creates some tension between conversations and your inner life. Do one thing at a time and the day will calm down.
With Mercury retrograde in your communication sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: If you have an agreement to make, put everything in writing.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: Today your body speaks louder. Drink water, take breaks and do not ignore tiredness.
The square between Mercury and Neptune creates some tension between money and friendships. You do not have to choose right now: look for the middle ground.
With Mercury retrograde in your money sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Go to bed half an hour earlier than usual.

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: With the Moon in your house of joy, creativity flows. Give shape to an idea you have been keeping to yourself.
The square between Mercury and Neptune creates some tension between your image and your career. Be firm, but without hardening your heart.
With Mercury retrograde in your self-image sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Spend half an hour on a hobby just for the pleasure of it.

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: Family and home take priority. A simple gesture of care has a very big effect today.
The square between Mercury and Neptune creates some tension between your inner life and your horizons. Breathe before reacting, because haste is the worst adviser today.
With Mercury retrograde in your inner life sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Put a plant or fresh flowers in your home.

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: Ideas come pouring in. Write them down: not all of them are for today, but some will be worth gold later on.
The square between Mercury and Neptune creates some tension between friendships and intimacy. If something goes wrong, it is just an adjustment and not the end.
With Mercury retrograde in your friendship sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Read a few pages of a book instead of spending the time on your phone.

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: The Moon passes through your area of money and security. It is a good day to look at your accounts calmly and without fear.
The square between Mercury and Neptune creates some tension between your career and relationships. Tension is a sign of growth, not of failure.
With Mercury retrograde in your career sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Review this week's spending and cut one thing you do not need.

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: With the Moon in your sign, your intuition is sharper than usual. Trust what you feel at first impression.
The square between Mercury and Neptune creates some tension between your horizons and routine. Say what you feel calmly and without blaming.
With Mercury retrograde in your horizons sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Do something for yourself that you have been putting off for weeks.

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: With the Moon in your house of silence, dreams and intuition bring answers. Watch for the signs.
The square between Mercury and Neptune creates some tension between intimacy and romance. Hear both sides before you decide.
With Mercury retrograde in your intimacy sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Walk alone and listen to your own thoughts.

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: The Moon favours sharing and helping one another. What you give to others comes back to you in other ways.
The square between Mercury and Neptune creates some tension between relationships and family. Protect your peace and choose the battles worth fighting.
With Mercury retrograde in your relationships sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Join a cause or help someone in need.

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: Others notice your effort. Do your best, even in the tasks nobody applauds.
The square between Mercury and Neptune creates some tension between routine and conversations. A short pause avoids a long argument.
With Mercury retrograde in your daily routine sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Dress like the person you want to be at work.

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: The Moon passes through your area of horizons. You feel like learning, travelling or simply seeing things differently.
The square between Mercury and Neptune creates some tension between romance and money. Today's challenge is teaching you patience.
With Mercury retrograde in your romance sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Look at a problem as if someone else were seeing it.
